channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Sea Machines pitches STEAMRACER autonomous ship
item.description: Sea Machines Robotics has announced that its STEAMRACER-class autonomous surface ship has advanced into the U.S. Navy final competitive evaluation phase under the Modular Attack Surface Combatant (MASC) programme. The post Sea Machines pitches STEAMRACER autonomous ship first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ajax to reach full capability by 2029 if not scrapped
item.description: The Government has confirmed that the Ajax armoured vehicle is expected to achieve Full Operating Capability by the end of 2029, provided the project survives an ongoing ministerial review. The post Ajax to reach full capability by 2029 if not scrapped first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: 16 Air Assault demos AI-enabled air manoeuvre strike
item.description: The British Army 16 Air Assault Brigade Combat Team has showcased AI-enabled recce-strike capabilities during a visit by the Chief of the General Staff, highlighting how the UK high-readiness force is integrating new tech to reinforce NATO at short notice. The post 16 Air Assault demos AI-enabled air manoeuvre strike first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: America targets 2026 milestone for new nuclear missile
item.description: The U.S. Air Force has confirmed that the restructuring of the LGM-35A Sentinel intercontinental ballistic missile programme is expected to be completed by the end of 2026, with initial operational capability targeted for the early 2030s. The post America targets 2026 milestone for new nuclear missile first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Naval vessel RFA Argus to be scrapped
item.description: RFA Argus will depart HMNB Portsmouth on 23 February for the final time, bringing more than four decades of service with the Royal Fleet Auxiliary to a close, the Royal Navy has confirmed. The post Naval vessel RFA Argus to be scrapped first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Dutch warship downs drones in drill off British coast
item.description: The Royal Netherlands Navy frigate HNLMS Evertsen recently shot down multiple aerial and surface drone threats during Exercise Sharpshooter off the Welsh coast, marking the first time a NATO ally has participated in the QinetiQ-run event, the company stated. The post Dutch warship downs drones in drill off British coast first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO launches drone-based deep strike capability
item.description: NATO Allies have agreed a new multinational initiative to develop drone-based deep precision strike capabilities, as part of a wider package of cooperative programmes aimed at strengthening deterrence and defence, the alliance stated. The post NATO launches drone-based deep strike capability first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK joins European push for low-cost air defence weapons
item.description: The UK has joined France, Germany, Italy and Poland in launching a new multinational initiative to develop low-cost air defence weapons aimed at countering drone and missile threats across Europe. The post UK joins European push for low-cost air defence weapons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American and Estonian divers train under ice in Baltic
item.description: U.S. Navy Seabee divers and Estonian counterparts have conducted ice diving and underwater demolition training in Estonia. The post American and Estonian divers train under ice in Baltic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: L3Harris wins major submarine comms contract
item.description: L3Harris Technologies has secured its largest full-rate production contract for U.S. Navy submarine communications systems. The post L3Harris wins major submarine comms contract first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
